cohort: Sixty children aged 1-6 years, belonging to American Society of Anaesthesiologists physical status I & II, scheduled for elective lower abdominal surgeries.
finding: Adding dexmedetomidine to ropivacaine in caudal blocks significantly prolonged the duration of analgesia and prevented emergence agitation in pediatric patients undergoing lower abdominal surgeries.
followup_time: Up to 13.66 hours post-operatively for duration of analgesia.
